Assessor
Assessor
The Assessor's Office is responsible for the valuation of all the tangible real and personal property within Perry County.
Perry County's 19,000 citizens own over 14,600 parcels of real estate and have over 11,000 personal property accounts with a certified assessed value of over $440 million as of 2023. Perry County is a third-class county.
Our Mission The Perry County Assessor's office strives to assess all property fairly, equally, and in a uniform manner under the laws of the State of Missouri, while providing the highest level of service and treating all taxpayers and citizens with utmost respect.
